bibliography.checked_against: Crossref and Maine DEP 2003's reference list (p. 43)
bibliography.note: Crossref: Likens, Bormann, Pierce, Eaton & Johnson 1977, Biogeochemistry of a Forested Ecosystem, Springer-Verlag New York, doi:10.1007/978-1-4615-9993-7. Maine DEP 2003 lists it as 'Bio-Geochemistry of a Forested Ecosystem … 146 pages'.

claims.claim: undeveloped forest is assigned 0.04 kg TP ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹, after 'a New England regional study' (Likens et al. 1977, via Maine DEP 2003)
claims.note: The book was not seen. The intermediary does say it: Maine DEP 2003, PDF p. 33, 'The phosphorus export coefficient for forested land (0.04) is based on a New England regional study (Likens et al 1977)', and its land-use table (PDF p. 31) gives non-developed land 0.01–0.04, used 0.04. So 'Maine DEP 2003, after Likens et al. 1977' reports DEP correctly. Caveat for the rewrite: Likens et al. 1977 is the Hubbard Brook Experimental Forest book (one set of small New Hampshire watersheds), not a regional study, and the paper's own Table 3.2-1 gives Hubbard Brook's measured stream export as ~0.02 (from another source) — so whether 0.04 is the book's number, or DEP's rounding up of it, is unknown until the book is read.
